'''''DJ Rangthang''''' was a [[Painting/Legends|poster]] advertisement<ref name="Deception" /> for [[Rangthang/Legends|Rang Thang]], a music [[DJ (occupation)/Legends|DJ]].<ref name="Hunt for Ziro">{{TCW|Hunt for Ziro}}</ref> It could be found in several different locations in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The poster had a black, beige and purple [[Color/Legends|color]] palette and showed the titular DJ against a building backdrop, with an [[Aurebesh]] caption spelling out the poster's name at the top. It was put up in the [[Trueping's/Legends|Trueping's]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]];<ref name="Deception" /> a [[Unidentified Turtle Tanker/Legends|Turtle Tanker]]<ref name="Revenge">{{TCW|Revenge (episode)}}</ref> commandeered by [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Stobar/Legends|Stobar]];<ref name="Brothers">{{TCW|Brothers (episode)}}</ref> in [[Pons Ora/Legends|Pons Ora]], a settlement on the planet [[Abafar/Legends|Abafar]];<ref name="Missing">{{TCW|Missing in Action}}</ref> outside [[Jackar Bowmani's apartment/Legends|Jackar Bowmani's apartment]] on Coruscant;<ref name="Sabotage">{{TCW|Sabotage (episode)}}</ref> and onboard a [[Hovertrain/Legends|Coruscant train]].<ref name="Catch">{{TCW|To Catch a Jedi}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Among the posters seen in the bar's back room where Hardeen sleeps is one for DJ Rangthang, one for Sy Snootles, a Felucian pin-up, and a travel poster for Pantora.|StarWars.com episode guide for "Deception"|<ref name="Trivia">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/deception-trivia-gallery|text="Deception" Trivia Gallery}} {{C|Slide 4}}</ref>}}
This poster was created for the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' episode "[[Deception]]" and was designed by concept artist [[Randy Bantog]].<ref name="Trivia" />
